caption:
Tag an Ox who's about to have a busy 2027 🐂

Born in 1961, 1973, 1985, 1997 or 2009? (Born in January or early February? You may be a Rat.) In 2027 the Goat sits opposite the Ox: the year clashes your animal. Tradition reads a clash as movement, not doom: a year that pushes you to change home, work or routine. Choose the change you want before it chooses you, and go easy on arguments and fine print.

The clash lands differently on every chart. Get your free chart at skyandseason.com (link in bio), open Calendar, go to February 2027 and see your own 2027 mark: Good, Steady or Care, for work, money and love.

Ox friends, what are you changing in 2027? Comment below.
